structured.answer: I didn't pick anything. There are 182 tracks that all look alike and the page doesn't recommend any of them. If I had to choose, I'd lean towards one of the S&P 500 tracks at a name I know, like מיטב or הפניקס (about 0.5–0.6% fee, around 13% over 3 years), but I wouldn't act on it today.

stuck.why: Row after row of the same names (גמל מניות, עוקב מדד S&P 500, משולב סחיר, לבני 50 ומטה), repeated for every company. It never ends and nothing says which one is good for me.
Two fees per row. I'm not sure which one actually matters, and they're all tiny percents, so they look the same to me.
Many rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' or 'לא דווח' instead of a number, so I can't compare them. The biggest one I saw, מיטב 'גמל משולב סחיר' at 28.61%, has no 5-year number.
This is where I got bored and would have closed it on the bus.
